sub_sector.value: Active fund and separate account management; private wealth management

financial_business_type.detail: Manages open-end and closed-end funds, ETFs, and separate accounts, provides personalized wealth management, and distributes its mutual funds.

revenue_driver.detail: Investment management fees from funds and separate accounts, plus mutual fund distribution fees.

customer_type.detail: Serves institutional clients and individual investors, including high-net-worth individuals and families, and partners with investment professionals.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Manages client assets in funds and separate accounts, with investors bearing the investment risk.

notes: Fee sources are inferred from the disclosed investment management and fund distribution activities.
